title: Peculiar Origins
description: A collection of 3 origins that i made
body:
The _**Peculiar Origins**_ Datapack is a pack that adds 3 new origins:
## **Doohickey** (2 impact)
## **Ghoul** (3 impact)
## **Goblin** (1 impact)

All of these origins have different attributes and powers such as:

# **Goblin**
## **Cave Dweller**
You spawn in a cave
## **Rocky Hands**
You break stones with your bare hands
## **Sunburned**
You burn in sunlight
# **Doohickey**
## **Drone**
You have wings
## **Hydrophobia**
You Die in water
# **Ghoul**
## **Fire-Fly**
You fly in the sun, but also burn while flying
## **Ghostly Hands**
You break blocks 60% faster
# 
and there are still many more abilites that each origin has
